preserve: All new engine/gameplay, telemetry, snapshot, asynchronous search and GPU capabilities; no changed game rules/formats/SIM_REVISION intended.
acceptance: Independent source/design review, simpler ownership/representation or clearly isolated platform policy.
Focused regression/exception/lifetime/conformance tests; per-tick GCS traces, exact AIT1 and replay data, saved-game continuation, simulation/replay/network acceptance.
Release binary per individual change versus untouched master and final combined; same flags/compiler/assets/seed/CPU allocation; no compilers overlap timing.
At least listed geometry/AI variety, independent holdout seeds, single/parallel/auto counts, CPU/GPU conformance; paired counterbalanced timing with repeated seeds.
Review per-scenario CPU/wall/peak RSS, not just aggregate; investigate credible regressions before acceptance. Uncertain speed is not a speed claim.
Check Linux plus available browser serial/threaded toolchains and state any unavailable mobile/Windows/macOS runtime coverage explicitly.
completed_games: Later final full-winner checks on fixed Playground/Oazis and at least one held-out layout; original one-hour cap retained.
boundaries: Frozen saves created from baseline with exact width/height/team/seed/player validation and SHA256; do not silently substitute failed generators/layouts. These seeds were not the prior performance cohort.
